subject: Kickoff coordination: handoff windows, prework checklist & meeting links
messages:
From: Jamie Carter <jamie.carter@crestviewhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@crestviewhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood kickoff coordination: aligning first week

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get started. We wanted to lock down a 60-minute kickoff to align the internal stakeholders and confirm prework responsibilities so we can hit the go-live milestone in September.

High-level asks:
- 60 minutes to cover scope, roles, timeline, and initial integration checklist
- Key attendees: IT lead, Security, Product/PM, and one engineer who will own the first integration sprint
- Any prework packets or short config guides we can circulate beforehand

Availability: our team is flexible the week of Aug 9–13; prefer mornings (ET). Can you propose 2–3 slots and a short agenda? Also, loop in procurement if we need to confirm the SOW before the implementation kickoff.

Thanks,
Jamie
Jamie Carter
Director of Product Integrations | Crestview Health
jamie.carter@crestviewhealth.com
+1 (617) 555-0147

Subject: RE: Redwood kickoff coordination: aligning first week

Hi Jamie — great to hear. Thanks for the attendees hint; that helps a lot. Proposing a few 60-minute windows (all ET):

Option A: Tue Aug 10, 10:00–11:00 AM ET
Option B: Wed Aug 11, 9:00–10:00 AM ET
Option C: Thu Aug 12, 11:30 AM–12:30 PM ET

Draft 60-minute agenda (we'll tighten once you confirm):
- 0–10m: Introductions & objectives
- 10–25m: Deployment scope + success metrics
- 25–40m: Integration touchpoints (API auth, data flows, routing)
- 40–50m: Roles, timelines, and immediate next steps
- 50–60m: Questions + confirm owners + schedule follow-ups

Prework we can send right away: short pre-kickoff checklist (what to prepare), a one-page integration checklist, and our access matrix template. Attaching the prework PDF and a blank roster template for your team to populate.

I'll hold Option A and B tentatively; Laura can help finalize attendee roster. Monica will cover implementation sequencing during the meeting. Do you want procurement on the call for SOW clarifications, or should we schedule a separate procurement sync?

Best,
Marcus
